docName.remove: Remove this PDF from the project
docName.label: Name of the exported PDF
docName.labelImages: Name of this group of images

toolbar.includeOnePage: Every page is skipped. Include at least one page to export.
toolbar.nothingToPrint: Nothing to print yet. Choose pieces and give them copies.

issues.label: Export problems
issues.fixPrint: Fix these, then export again. Pieces are never scaled to fit.
issues.fixSource: Fix these pages, or skip them, then export again.

warnings.label: Print quality warnings
warnings.blurry: {{name}} will look blurry at this size ({{dpi}} dpi).
warnings.soft: {{name}} may print a little soft ({{dpi}} dpi).
warnings.missing: {{name}} was not found: this page prints blank.
warnings.note: These do not stop the export.

viewport.openHint: Open a PDF to get started (Ctrl/Cmd+O)
viewport.pageSkipped: This page is skipped: it is left out of the export.

preview.title: Preview
preview.selectRegion: Select the piece region on the page to preview the result.
preview.overflow: Layout exceeds the page by {{width}} horizontally and {{height}} vertically. Pieces are never scaled: change the page size or orientation, or reduce spacing or margins.

source.skippedRange_one: {{range}} is left out of the export.
source.skippedRange_other: {{range}} are left out of the export.
source.dragRegion: Drag on the page to select the region the pieces occupy.
source.gapNote: Gap already between pieces in the PDF.
source.outputNote: The output gap between pieces, the page size and margins, and which pieces go on which sheet, are set in the Print tab.

freeform.title: Freeform pieces
freeform.none: No freeform pieces on this page. They are printed from the Print tab.
freeform.count_one: {{count}} freeform piece on this page. It is printed from the Print tab.
freeform.count_other: {{count}} freeform pieces on this page. They are printed from the Print tab.
freeform.chooseTool: Choose the Piece tool (C) to move, resize or rotate them.
freeform.drawHint: Drag on the page to draw a piece, and click one to edit it. Drag the dot above a piece to rotate it; Shift snaps to 15°.

pages.skippedTitle: Skipped: left out of the export
pages.addPdfTitle: Add another PDF to this project. Its pieces join the piece library.
pages.addImagesTitle: Adds PNG, JPEG or WebP images as pieces, one per page.

applyGrid.title: Apply this grid to…
applyGrid.description: Copies the grid and piece region of page {{page}} ({{rows}}×{{columns}}). Each target becomes its own group, so you can then edit it on its own.
applyGrid.onlyThisPage: Only this page (detach it from its group)
applyGrid.sameSize: All pages of the same size (skipped pages stay skipped)
applyGrid.skippedNoGrid: This page is skipped, so it has no grid to copy.

library.openPdf: Open a PDF to see its pieces.
library.makePortraitTitle: Turn the selected pieces that are wider than tall, so they are all portrait
library.makeLandscapeTitle: Turn the selected pieces that are taller than wide, so they are all landscape
library.modeAll: Every piece prints once. Change the copies of a piece to print a custom selection.
library.modeCustom: Only pieces with copies are printed.
library.emptyNone: No pieces yet. Draw the piece region on a page in the Source tab.

thumb.label: p{{page}} · {{position}}
thumb.title: Page {{page}}, {{position}} · {{size}}
thumb.commonBack: Common back of the pieces without one

library.pickingBack: Click the piece to use as the back of the selection. Esc cancels.

error.note: Pieces are never scaled. Change the page, spacing or margins, or auto-fit the page.

plan.allHint: Every piece once, as the source lays them out.
plan.customHint: Only the pieces you give copies, e.g. 4 × A, 2 × B, 3 × C.
plan.autoFillHint: Repeat the pieces until the last sheet is full.
plan.groupedHint: A A A A, B B, C C C
plan.interleavedHint: A B C, A B C, A C, A
plan.orderNote: The order only matters when the sheet grid is not the source's.

sheet.sameNote: “Same as source” is for all pieces in order, as the page has them: no auto-fill, and no freeform, turned, resized or reordered pieces. Auto is used instead.
sheet.groupBySizeHint: Pieces of different sizes get their own sheets. Off: one shared grid, slots as large as the largest piece.
sheet.outputGapNote: Final gap between pieces. Independent of the source gap.

selected.title: Selected pieces
selected.empty: Select pieces in the piece library to turn them or set their real size.
selected.backToPage: Back to the size on the page
selected.sameNote: Setting a width or height keeps the piece's shape. 100% is the size on the page.
selected.differNote: These pieces differ in size: set a percentage, or select pieces of one size to give a real size.

marks.note: Marks are printed on the front sheets only. Ticks start past the bleed.

bleed.mirrorNote: The edge strip of each piece is drawn again, flipped over the edge. It stays vector.
bleed.sourceNote: Uses what the source PDF has between pieces. Needs at least this much space between them there.
bleed.note: Pieces keep their size: the bleed is extra art around each one. Leave room for it in the output gap and the margins.

duplex.onHint: A back sheet after every front sheet, mirrored so the backs line up when the paper is turned over.
duplex.offsetNote: Moves everything on the back sheets, to correct the printer's drift between sides. Right and down are positive.
duplex.useSelected: Use the selected piece as common back
duplex.backNote: A piece with no back of its own gets the common back; with neither, its place stays empty on the back sheet.

warnings.marks_off_page: Some cut marks fall outside the page: leave larger margins.
warnings.gap_too_narrow_for_line: A gap is too narrow for a line, or there is none: use ticks or widen the output gap.
warnings.bleed_overlaps_neighbour: The bleeds of neighbouring pieces overlap: make the output gap at least twice the bleed.
warnings.bleed_off_page: The bleed goes past the edge of the page: leave larger margins.
warnings.back_size_differs: A back is not the same size as its front, so the cuts will not line up.
warnings.bleed_exceeds_source_gap: The source has less space between some pieces than the bleed.

sheets.openPdf: Open a PDF to plan the sheets.
sheets.nothing: Nothing to print yet. Choose pieces in the piece library and give them copies, or switch the plan back to all pieces.

general.unitNote: Only changes how lengths are shown and typed. The document itself is never altered.
general.languageNote: Changes apply immediately. System follows the language of your computer.
general.decimalNote: Only changes how numbers are shown. Number fields accept both 63.5 and 63,5 whatever this is set to.

workspace.visibleNote: The view switcher shows these, in this order. At least one must stay enabled.
workspace.defaultNote: Used when a document opens. Switching views while editing does not change it.
workspace.layoutNote: Changes apply immediately. The Panels menu in the toolbar can always bring a hidden panel back.
workspace.resetNote: Restores panel positions and sizes, the visible views and the default view. Units, language, theme and Live Preview are kept.

livePreview.title: Live preview
livePreview.manualHint: The preview updates only when you press Refresh preview.
livePreview.note: With Manual, the Preview view refreshes each time you open it, and the Split view has a refresh button (a dot on it means the preview is out of date). Changing this applies to the open document immediately.

about.title: About
about.openBrowser: This will open your web browser at:
about.openFailed: The link could not be opened.

footer.confirm: Reset all preferences? This restores the default application settings. Your document is not affected.

help.welcomeNote: A short tour of the app, in four clips.
help.tipsHidden_one: {{count}} help tip is hidden because you closed it. Enable it to see it again.
help.tipsHidden_other: {{count}} help tips are hidden because you closed them. Enable them to see them again.
help.bugIntro: If something doesn't work, open an issue on GitHub (you need a free GitHub account) and tell us:
help.bugVersion: which version you use and on which system (the button below copies it)
help.bugSteps: what you did, step by step, so someone else can make it happen again
help.bugExpected: what you expected, and what happened instead
help.bugWorkaround: whether you found a way around it
help.bugFiles: the PDF or project, if you can share it (only files you're allowed to share), or a screenshot
help.infoUnavailable: The app info is only available in the app window.
help.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text above and copy it yourself.

mark.title: Mark the pieces
mark.text: Drag a rectangle around all the pieces on the page.

grid.title: Set the grid
grid.text: Enter how many columns and rows of pieces there are.

overlay.title: Check the overlay
overlay.text: The grid lines should sit on the pieces. If not, drag the rectangle's handles to adjust it.

goPrint.title: Go to Print
goPrint.text: Open the Print tab to choose which pieces go on which sheet.

one.title: One piece at a time
one.text: Drag on the page to draw a piece, and click a piece to edit it: drag its body to move it, its handles to resize it and the dot above it to rotate it (Shift snaps to 15°). These pieces are printed from the Print tab.

main.text: Live preview is off, so this preview isn't generated automatically. Press the refresh button (bottom right) to generate it. You can change this in Preferences > Preview.

Live preview is off, so the row of sheet previews above is not redrawn as you change the plan. Press the refresh button (top right) to update it. The large sheet always follows the plan. You can change this in Preferences > Preview.

library.title: Choose pieces
library.text: Pick the pieces you want in the piece library.

copies.title: Set copies
copies.text: Give each piece the number of copies you need, or keep “All pieces in order” to print every piece once.

sheet.title: Sheet and page
sheet.text: Adjust the sheet layout, spacing and page in the print settings.

export.title: Export
export.text: When the sheets look right, export the PDF.

errors.does_not_fit: The laid-out pieces need {{needed_w_mm}} × {{needed_h_mm}} mm but the sheet is only {{page_w_mm}} × {{page_h_mm}} mm.
errors.page_out_of_range: Page {{page}} does not exist (the document has {{count}} pages).
errors.unsupported_rotation: Page {{page}} has a rotation of {{rotate}}°; only multiples of 90° are supported.
errors.unsupported_user_unit: Page {{page}} has a /UserUnit of {{unit}}; only 1 is supported.
errors.superseded: A newer request replaced this one.
errors.worker_stopped: The renderer stopped. Restart the app.
errors.same_file: Choose a different file than the one that is open.
errors.no_pages: No pages are included in the export.
errors.internal: Something went wrong inside the app: {{detail}}
errors.freeform_only: This page has only freeform pieces: print it from the Print tab.
errors.not_a_project: This is not a valid project file.
errors.project_too_new: This project was made with a newer version of the app (file version {{found}}; this version reads up to {{supported}}). Please update.
errors.project_invalid: This project file is damaged or incomplete.
errors.bleed_exceeds_source_gap: The source has {{gap_mm}} mm between some pieces, less than the {{bleed_mm}} mm of bleed taken from it.
errors.ai_no_key: No API key is saved for this provider. Add one in Preferences › AI Mode.
errors.ai_keychain: The system keychain could not be used: {{detail}}
errors.ai_timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
errors.ai_invalid_reply: The reply could not be read: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
errors.ai_invalid_proposal: The proposal does not fit: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
errors.ai_text_only_needs_objects: This page has no objects to describe. Turn on “Send page images” in Preferences › AI Mode.
errors.image_unsupported: “{{name}}” can't be used. Images can be PNG, JPEG or WebP.
errors.image_too_large: “{{name}}” is too large ({{megapixels}} megapixels, {{mb}} MB). The limits are 100 megapixels and 200 MB.

presets.title: Presets
presets.none: No presets yet. Save the current grid to reuse it on other page groups.
presets.applyTitle: Sets the rows, columns and source gap of the pages that share this grid
presets.name: Preset name
presets.saveTitle: Save the rows, columns and source gap of this page group under this name

discard.message: This project has changes that are not saved. Discard them?

project.noModify: “{{name}}” is marked as “no modify” by its author. Opening it works, but the exported PDF is a new file, so check that you are allowed to rearrange it.

remove.message: Remove “{{name}}” from the project? Its pieces leave the piece library and the sheets. The file on disk is not touched.
remove.messageLast: This is the only PDF of the project. Remove “{{name}}”? The project will be left empty. The file on disk is not touched.

relink.message: Where is “{{name}}” now? Choose the PDF to keep opening the project.
relink.differs: This file is not the same as the PDF “{{name}}” the project was saved with, so the pieces may not be where they were. Use it anyway?

notices.label: Project messages
notices.pdfChanged: “{{name}}” has changed since the project was saved. Check that the pieces are still where you marked them.
notices.layoutReset: “{{name}}” has a different number of pages than when the project was saved, so its page groups and pieces were reset.
notices.imageChanged: “{{name}}” has changed since the project was saved. Its page now shows the new image.
notices.imagesMissing: Some images of “{{name}}” were not found. Their pages stay blank until you add the images again.

detect.title: Detect pieces
detect.note: Proposes where the pieces are on this page, found on your computer. Nothing changes until you apply it.
detect.none: No pieces found on this page. Draw the region by hand.
detect.onThePage: The proposal is on the page: check the outlines, then apply it.
detect.lowWarning: Low confidence: check the outlines before applying.

notes.missing_cells: Some places of the grid have no object: the last row may not be full.
notes.crop_marks: Crop marks in the margins line up with the grid.
notes.few_objects: Only a few objects back this, so check it.
notes.touches_edge: A piece touches the edge of the page.
notes.merged_pieces: Some shapes were not clean rectangles: pieces that touch cannot be told apart.
notes.no_regular_pattern: The art seems to run across the piece borders, so no regular pattern shows.

modelHint.anthropic: A Claude model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-5-5 or claude-haiku-5-5.
modelHint.openai_compatible: A model that reads images, with the address of its server, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, https://api.x.ai/v1 or http://localhost:1234/v1.
modelHint.gemini: A Gemini model id, e.g. gemini-2.5-flash.
modelHint.ollama: A vision model you have pulled, e.g. llava or llama3.2-vision.

settings.title: AI Mode (experimental)
settings.enableNote: Adds AI buttons that send pages to a provider you choose, with your own key. Off by default. Nothing is sent unless you press one and confirm.
settings.baseUrlNote: Leave empty for the provider's own address. Plain http is only accepted for this computer or a private network.
settings.keySaved: A key is saved in the system keychain.
settings.keyReplace: Paste a new key to replace it
settings.keyNote: The key goes straight to the system keychain. It is never shown again and never saved in a project or in these preferences.
settings.sendImagesOn: Pages are sent as pictures. Before every action you see which pages go to which server.
settings.sendImagesOff: Text only: no picture is ever sent. The model gets sizes, counts of objects and the start of each page's text.
settings.testOk: Connected. Used {{input}} input and {{output}} output tokens.
settings.workspaceNote: Only for an API key that is not scoped to a workspace: the ID of the workspace to use, sent as the anthropic-workspace-id header. Leave empty otherwise.
settings.testSends: Sends a short test message to {{provider}}

confirm.title: Send to {{provider}}?
confirm.detectImage: Page {{page}} will be sent as a picture, about {{size}} px on its long side.
confirm.detectText: Text only: no picture is sent. The model gets the page size and the boxes of its images and rectangles.
confirm.sortImages: {{count}} pages ({{range}}) will be sent as small pictures, about {{size}} px, in {{requests}} requests.
confirm.sortText: Text only: no picture is sent. {{count}} pages ({{range}}) are described to the model (size, counts of objects, start of the text) in {{requests}} requests.
confirm.estimate: About {{input}} input tokens and up to {{output}} output tokens.
confirm.noCost: No price is known for this model.
confirm.dontAsk: Don't ask again before detecting on one page, until I close the app

detect.note: Asks the AI provider where the pieces are on this page. Nothing changes until you apply the proposal.

sort.title: Sort pages
sort.note: Labels every page (cards, backs, rules, cover, other) so pages without pieces can be skipped. Nothing changes until you apply it.
sort.sends: Sends the pages of this PDF to {{provider}}

experimental.title: AI Mode is experimental
experimental.text: AI Mode still needs further testing and may not work as expected. It can be token hungry: every action sends pages to your provider, and the tokens cost money. Use it at your own responsibility.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Press ? at any time to open this list.

items.undo: Undo the last change (in either tab)
items.closeDialog: Close a dialog, a menu or an info tip
items.snapRotation: Rotate a piece in 15° steps (hold while turning it)
items.selectMore: Add or remove a piece from the selection
items.revertNumber: Go back to the previous number
items.nudgeFine: Raise or lower it in small steps
items.nudgeCoarse: Raise or lower it in big steps

start.title: Get started
start.lead: Open a Print-and-Play PDF to space its pieces, or pick up a project.
start.shortcuts: Press ? to see the keyboard shortcuts.

images.changed: “{{name}}” is not the same image the project was saved with. Use it instead?

badge.missingTitle: This image was not found, so this piece is blank.
badge.softTitle: About {{dpi}} dpi at this size: it may print a little soft.
badge.blurryTitle: About {{dpi}} dpi at this size: it will look blurry.

dialog.label: Add images
dialog.lead: Each image becomes a piece. Choose the size it prints at; images are never stretched or resampled.
dialog.fromImageOff: From the image (not every file has a resolution)
dialog.bleedInfo: The page is the piece size plus the bleed on every side, so “bleed from the source” in the Print tab uses the image's own bleed.
dialog.differLead_one: This image is not the shape of the piece. It is never stretched.
dialog.differLead_other: These images are not the shape of the piece. They are never stretched.
dialog.fitHint: Fit shows the whole image with blank margins; Fill covers the piece and cuts off what does not fit.
dialog.soft: {{dpi}} dpi at this size: may print a little soft.
dialog.blurry: {{dpi}} dpi at this size: will look blurry.
dialog.exportSize: Adds about {{size}} to the exported PDF.
dialog.veryLarge: {{dpi}} dpi: much sharper than any printer needs. Adds about {{size}}; the exported PDF will be large.
dialog.reduce: Reduce very large images to 600 dpi
dialog.reduceHint: PNG and WebP images above 600 dpi are shrunk to 600 dpi (still lossless). JPEG images are never reduced: that would mean compressing them again and losing quality. Your files are not touched.

cut.title: Your PDF, cut into pieces
cut.text: Mark where the pieces are on a page: a grid, Detect pieces, or one by one with the piece tool.

place.title: On the sheet you print
place.text: Pick a sheet size such as A4 or Letter. Your pieces keep their exact size.

arrange.title: Arrange them your way
arrange.text: Put the pieces in the order you want, set the gap between them, and choose which ones to print and how many copies.

done.title: Ready to cut
done.text: Export a PDF with cut marks, bleed or duplex if you want. Your artwork is never changed.
